title: Polynomial work bound in the sub-square-root regime
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be natural numbers, let $t>0$ be rational, and let $0<\epsilon\le 1/2$ be rational. Suppose $n\ge1$, $1/(Q+1)\le\epsilon$, and $t\le(C+1)(\sqrt{\operatorname{clog}_2(n+1)}+1)$. Then $2^{42}(n+1)^3(B+1)^8/\epsilon^{10}\le K(n+1)^E$, where $B$ is the family bound determined by $t$ and $\epsilon$, $K$ is the work constant determined by $C,Q$, and $E$ is the work exponent determined by $C,Q$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is a positive rational influence bound
